scenes.squall: SQUALL LEONHART: handsome reserved young man with straight medium brown hair swept into a center part, unmistakable diagonal scar across bridge of nose, blue-gray eyes, black short leather jacket with thick white fur collar, white shirt, black belts and trousers, silver Griever lion necklace. Quiet night on Balamb Garden balcony after the graduation dance: he leans one forearm on railing, the other hand loosely holding his iconic silver Revolver GUNBLADE at a downward diagonal across lower central frame. The gunblade has broad steel sword blade with revolver cylinder and grip, not a rifle; blade clearly readable. He turns his face toward the unseen doorway, caught between guarded loneliness and first shy hope, softened eyes and almost-smile, subtle vulnerability. A few distant warm ballroom lights through windows and cool open sky, architectural curved Garden railing and distant sea, no crowds. Warm rim on fur, moonlight on steel, authentic intimate character moment.
scenes.zell: ZELL DINCHT: energetic muscular young martial artist, upright spiky blond crest, distinct black tribal tattoo down LEFT side of his face, blue jacket with dark sleeves over white shirt, red-and-black fingerless combat gloves, loose dark shorts/trousers. Balamb Garden cafeteria, finally catching the last bread roll before a mission: a delighted disbelieving grin, warm mischievous eyes, holding the roll securely in one gloved fist at chest height, other clenched gloved fist raised in small spontaneous triumph. A fighter's athletic stance, exuberance and appetite, not silly caricature. Modest sunlit counter and a couple of empty simple chairs, clean cream architecture and green courtyard glimpse. Fists remain prominent; no sword/gun. A tender funny recognizably Zell memory painted with dignity and life.
scenes.linoa: RINOA HEARTILLY, French name LINOA: recognizable young woman with long straight black hair with subtle brown highlights framing face, warm brown eyes, long sleeveless blue knitted duster with white angel-wing motif on back, black fitted modest top, practical black shorts, blue arm warmers and tall boots. The moment of liberation from the Sorceress Memorial in Esthar: stepping out of the opened tall containment capsule, reaching her RIGHT bare hand forward toward someone just offscreen, eyes shining with relief through a restrained tear and a brave small smile. LEFT wrist clearly wears her iconic compact silver crescent Blaster Edge projectile launcher, not a pistol; blade elegantly readable by her lower torso. The person rescuing her stays offscreen. Cool pale futuristic oval chamber behind, warm light touches her extended fingers. Hints of white wing-like light, not giant extra wings. Convey fear giving way to trust, not distressed helplessness. Important face and launcher centered.
scenes.irvine: IRVINE KINNEAS: tall slender long-haired young cowboy sniper, chestnut hair loosely tied behind, brown cowboy hat, long tan duster with broad collar over purple shirt, dark trousers and boots. Inside the Deling City clock tower on parade night: his long familiar sniper rifle supported on a stone sill, angled diagonally through lower central picture with clear stock, hands and barrel. He hesitates one instant before aiming; brows strained, eyes full of painful recognition and doubt, controlled trembling fingertips, lips pressed together. Face visible beneath hat, not hidden in shadow. His swagger falls away because he remembers the woman below as Matron. Golden-lit triumphal arch seen distantly through the tall opening, ceremonial red lights, quiet deep indigo city. No scope UI, no victim, no gore. A human moment of nerve rather than generic shooting action.
scenes.quistis: QUISTIS TREPE: recognizable young blonde woman, long tied-back blonde hair with two loose front strands, thin-rimmed glasses, salmon/peach sleeveless high-collared fitted uniform dress with long modest skirt and dark boots, dark belt. At the secluded moonlit overlook of Balamb Garden Training Center, lush dark foliage and glass structure only at margins. One hand rests on the railing; the other holds her long whip coiled naturally beside her, handle and readable flowing coil inside center frame. She looks back over her shoulder with a wistful, thoughtful expression, lonely disappointment giving way to composed resolve. Her face and glasses clearly lit by cool moonlight and one subdued warm garden lamp. Respectful self-possessed portrait, no suggestive pose. Simple foliage, few huge leaves and distant academy lights, not jungle clutter. No staff or sword.
scenes.selphie: SELPHIE TILMITT: recognizable small youthful woman, short chestnut bob with outward-flipped ends, bright green eyes, modest yellow sleeveless zip-front dress, black knee-high boots. Visiting shattered Trabia Garden after the missile strike: kneeling briefly on one knee beside a small memorial flower patch, gently placing a yellow flower, tear at the corner of one eye but chin lifted in fierce resilient hope. Her user's Kalistar crossover weapon is explicitly a LANCE, not canon nunchaku: a simple elegant silver spear rests safely against her shoulder, she steadies its shaft in her other hand, spearhead fully visible within the upper-middle image. Do not change this weapon to nunchaku. Cold clear blue sky over a few broken white school arches and patches of snow, quiet respectful setting, no bodies or violence. Yellow dress and flower bring warmth into muted blue-gray stone. Emotional, grounded, no melodramatic huge tears.
scenes.edea: SORCERESS EDEA KRAMER from FF8: adult regal pale woman with distinctive elaborate gold fanlike/horned crescent headdress, dark hair drawn up beneath it, intense amber eyes, purple lip color, dramatic black feather shoulder mantle and long elegant black gown with dignified fitted bodice. At Deling City's night inauguration parade, standing on her ceremonial platform with one slender gloved hand raised, a single bright sculptural ice shard suspended above her palm. Face is cold, commanding, faintly tragic, smile restrained and imperious, not cartoon evil. Make the iconic headdress readable without filling every edge. Ceremonial arch, a few warm parade lamps and deep blue city at distance, no legible words or crowds in foreground. Black feathers against cool silver-blue ice and dark red curtains, rich restrained painting. Her magical gesture is the weapon, do not force a huge staff into the scene.
scenes.seifer: SEIFER ALMASY: tall broad-shouldered young blond man with slicked-back hair, thin diagonal forehead/nose scar, long light gray military trenchcoat with dark cross emblems on sleeves, black shirt and gloves, confident stance. Deling City parade palace passage: defending the way to the sorceress as her self-appointed knight. His iconic HYPERION gunblade has a long straight sword blade and integrated pistol grip, carried across the lower central frame in his characteristic one-handed stance, other hand extended behind to guard the passage. Expression: fierce proud half-smile mixed with desperate need to matter, eyes intensely committed. A restrained tongue of fire follows blade edge, not obscuring metal. A red-lit stone arch and single distant parade lamp, no busy crowds. Readable face, long coat and whole useful sword segment, not a generic villain.
scenes.ward: WARD ZABAC: giant, heavy muscular middle-aged man with short brown hair, distinctive large scar on his face, dark blue knit cap, blue sleeveless Galbadian work/military vest over light shirt, broad belt, practical trousers and heavy boots. A weary protective veteran, not a knight. At a windswept Centra excavation cliff overlooking sea during Laguna's dream-sequence escape: braced on one knee, shoulder bruised but no blood/gore, gripping his enormous recognizable HARPOON spear as a walking support held diagonally inside the central frame. He looks back toward his unseen friends with calm, warm stubborn loyalty despite pain, not roaring. His size feels monumental and paternal, jaw determined. Silver-gray ocean, a few rocky excavation blocks and open pale sky, no dense city. Strictly NO crystal, magical glow, elemental particles or magical weapon effects. Harpoon is physical weathered steel, natural sunlight and salt spray only.
scenes.kiros: KIROS SEAGILL: tall very slender athletic dark-skinned man with very long black dreadlock braids, calm angular face, recognizable red-brown sleeveless vest and fitted dark trousers, long silver earrings, paired crescent katars/daggers on hands. Returning to Winhill to find Laguna alive: he stands in a quiet stone village lane beside the inn doorway, one foot just stepping in, shoulders relaxing with a dry affectionate half-smile and genuine relief in his eyes, looking toward an unseen friend. Both crescent blades point safely downward close to his hips and remain inside the central composition, no aggressive attack. Warm afternoon sun on old pale stone, few flowers by a wooden window, leafy distant hill and blue sky, restrained background. Not an assassin hiding in dark ruins. Strictly NO magic, crystal, colored aura or glowing weapon; both blades are normal steel. Preserve dignity, wit, and understated reunion emotion.
